title: Grammar — Be, Present Simple & Continuous, Past Simple (My Next Grammar, Lessons 4-8)
intro: Mixed review across Lessons 4-8: be verbs, present simple, present continuous, past simple regular and irregular verbs. Tense choice from time clues, hidden subjects, error spotting, and rewrites at the Grade 5 high-standard level. Includes the exact textbook exercises from My Next Grammar 2, Lessons 6-8.

explanation.title: Be, Present, and Past Tenses Quick Guide
explanation.intro: 期中考 Grammar 範圍是 My Next Grammar Book 2 第 4–8 課：be 動詞、現在簡單式、現在進行式、規則動詞過去式、不規則動詞過去式。第 4–5 課是 Quiz 1 複習，重點在第 6–8 課。看時間線索選時態，再看主詞決定單複數。

cards.formula: I am / he, she, it is / you, we, they are · I, he, she, it was / you, we, they were
cards.meaning: be 動詞表示狀態。現在用 am / is / are，過去用 was / were。否定加 not（isn't, wasn't, weren't），問句把 be 移到主詞前面，不需要 do / did。
examples: The garden was locked for ten years.
The portholes were too small to see out.
Were you scared during the storm? Yes, I was.

cards.formula: he / she / it + verb-s · I / you / we / they + verb · doesn't / don't + base · Does…? Do…?
cards.meaning: 一般現在式說習慣、事實。第三人稱單數加 -s / -es / -ies。否定和問句用 do / does，後面動詞回到原形。
examples: The poem ends with the same refrain.
The robin doesn't fly far from the garden.
Does the captain check the map every morning?

cards.meaning: 現在進行式說「現在正在做」的事。be 動詞要跟主詞一致，後面接 -ing。看到 now、right now、at the moment、Look!、Listen! 就用進行式。
examples: Look! The airship is flying above the clouds.
The children are watering the roses right now.
Listen! Someone is singing in the garden.

cards.formula: sing → singing · study → studying (most verbs: add -ing) · make → making · smile → smiling (consonant + e: drop e) · hit → hitting · run → running · swim → swimming (consonant + vowel + consonant: double) · exceptions: showing, fixing, staying
cards.meaning: 課本三條規則：大部分動詞直接加 -ing；子音＋e 結尾去 e 加 -ing；子音＋母音＋子音結尾重複最後的子音再加 -ing。例外：字尾是 w、x、y 不重複（showing, fixing, staying）。補充：ie 改 y（lie → lying）；兩音節重音在前不重複（visit → visiting）。
examples: Dickon is lying in the grass.
We are swimming in the lake.
Mary is visiting the garden again.

cards.formula: isn't / aren't + -ing · Is he…ing? Are they…ing? · Yes, he is. / No, they aren't. · know, like, want, believe, belong → no -ing
cards.meaning: 進行式的否定和問句用 be 動詞，不用 do / does。狀態動詞（知道、喜歡、想要、相信、屬於）表示想法或擁有，不是動作，通常不用進行式。
examples: Colin isn't walking alone. Is Mary helping him? Yes, she is.
I know the answer. (not: I am knowing)
This old key belongs to Mary.

cards.formula: Present simple = habitual action: every day / week / month · on Sundays · in the morning, at night · once / twice a week · Present continuous = temporary action: (right) now · at the moment
cards.meaning: 一般現在式是習慣或事實；現在進行式是此刻正在發生。同一句可能兩個都有：前面說習慣，後面說今天的不同。
examples: My teacher wears a dress once a week. My teacher is wearing jeans now.
They walk to school every day. They are going to school by bus now.
Jack plays basketball on Sundays. Jack is swimming in the pool at the moment.

cards.formula: cook → cooked · learn → learned (add -ed) · use → used · wave → waved (e: add -d) · try → tried · worry → worried (consonant + y: y → i + -ed) · drop → dropped · hop → hopped · rub → rubbed (double) · exceptions: showed, fixed, stayed
cards.meaning: 規則動詞過去式加 -ed。字尾 e 只加 -d；子音＋y 改 -ied；母音＋y 直接加 -ed；短母音＋單一子音重複子音（stop, plan, hop）。兩個音節重音在後才重複（prefer, admit），重音在前不重複（visit, open, listen）。seize 是規則動詞：seized。
examples: The robin hopped along the wall. (hope → hoped 是「希望」)
Mary hesitated, then she opened the door.
The captain seized the rope just in time.

cards.formula: didn't + base verb · Did + subject + base verb? · Yes, I did. / No, she didn't. · Wh- + did + subject + base?
cards.meaning: 過去式的否定和問句用 did / didn't，所有主詞都一樣。用了 did，後面動詞一定回到原形，不能再加 -ed 或用不規則過去式。
examples: We didn't visit the museum last weekend.
Did the airship land safely? Yes, it did.
Where did they bury the key ten years ago?

cards.formula: /d/ after voiced sounds: learned, peeled, rubbed · /t/ after voiceless sounds (f, h, k, p, s, x, ch, sh): cooked, dropped, washed · /id/ after t or d: added, visited · time words: yesterday, last…, …ago, in + year
cards.meaning: 看到 yesterday、last…、…ago、in 2019 就用過去式。-ed 三種唸法：字尾是 t / d 唸 /id/（added, visited, wanted, needed）；無聲子音 f, h, k, p, s, x, ch, sh 後面唸 /t/（cooked, dropped, washed, helped, looked）；有聲音 b, g, l, m, n, r, v, w, y 後面唸 /d/（learned, peeled, rubbed, opened, smelled）。有聲音是喉嚨會震動的音，無聲音只靠嘴巴送氣。
examples: learned /d/ · cooked /t/ · visited /id/
opened /d/ · helped /t/ · needed /id/
We moved to Taipei in 2019.

cards.formula: build → built · buy → bought · catch → caught · come → came · do → did · drink → drank · eat → ate · feel → felt · give → gave · go → went · have → had · hear → heard · know → knew · leave → left · make → made · meet → met · read → read · ride → rode · run → ran · say → said · see → saw · sing → sang · sit → sat · sleep → slept · swim → swam · teach → taught · think → thought · write → wrote · also: take → took · bring → brought · fly → flew · begin → began · grow → grew · throw → threw
cards.meaning: 不規則動詞要背。小心長得像的：brought（帶來）/ bought（買）、thought（想）/ taught（教）。過去式 went / saw / wrote 單獨用；gone / seen / written 是過去分詞，前面要有 have / has，不能單獨當過去式。
examples: I saw a shooting star last night. (not: I seen)
He went to the library an hour ago. (not: He gone)
The whole airship shook during the storm.

cards.formula: one of / each of / everyone / nobody → singular · subject + phrase → head noun · along with → first subject · news → singular · scissors → plural
cards.meaning: 高標題常把主詞藏起來。把 of the …、in the …、along with … 蓋住，找真正的主詞再決定 is / are、was / were、verb-s。過去式一般動詞不分單複數，但 was / were 要分。
examples: One of the passengers is looking through the porthole.
Each of the passengers was looking out the window.
The captain, along with his crew, is steering the airship.

cards.formula: Was / Were + adjective, noun, place, or -ing · Did + base verb
cards.meaning: 後面是形容詞、名詞、地點或 -ing（狀態）用 was / were；後面是動作動詞原形用 did。不能同時用：Did you were…? 和 Were you go…? 都錯。
examples: Were you at home last night? (place → were)
Did you see the airship last night? (action → did)
Was it cold yesterday? Yes, it was.

tips: 先看時間線索：now / Look! / Listen! / at the moment → am / is / are + -ing；every day / usually / always → 一般現在式；yesterday / last… / ago / in 2019 → 過去式。
did、didn't、does、doesn't、do、don't 後面的動詞一律回到原形：didn't go（不是 didn't went）、Did you see（不是 Did you saw）。
went / saw 是過去式，gone / seen 不能單獨用：I saw it yesterday.（不是 I seen it）
know、like、want、believe、belong 是狀態動詞，不用 -ing：I want a drink.（不是 I am wanting）
-ing 拼字：make → making、run → running、lie → lying、visit → visiting、begin → beginning、travel → traveling（美式）。
-ed 拼字：stop → stopped、plan → planned、prefer → preferred、visit → visited、study → studied、play → played。seize 是規則動詞 → seized。
小心長得像的字：bought（buy）/ brought（bring）、thought（think）/ taught（teach）、hopped（hop）/ hoped（hope）。
找真正的主詞：one of / each of / everyone 是單數 → is / was / verb-s；把 of the … 和 along with … 蓋住再看。
改寫題先確認時態再套公式：過去式否定 didn't + 原形；進行式否定 isn't / aren't + -ing；be 動詞直接加 not。
